observation.hypothesis: Layer-23 down_proj columns 20/25/43 act as a gate that is high at concluded line-breaks; adding alpha*u*r^T to those columns adds alpha*s*u to the final residual, moving conclusion-like states along the observed decision direction u=unit(x_dec-x_ctrl) and raising P(</think>).
observation.value_derivation: alpha chosen so the near-conclusion state (s=4.06, proj 5.04) gains the gap to the decision level (7.26-5.04=2.22): alpha=2.22/4.06=0.547 -> 0.54. Predicted shifts: dec +2.5 (to ~9.8), ctrl <=+0.72 (stay <1.2), loop s=2.5 -> +1.35 (to ~2.2, still below near-conclusion). Delta Frobenius = 0.54; changed entries 3072/3.67M = 0.084%.
alternatives: u encodes content of only 2 decision contexts
loop states may have low gate so no behavior change
logit sensitivity along u unknown; effect may be too small/large

basis.failure_description: 60/64 validation generations never emit </think> and hit the 32768 cutoff; e.g. gsm8k_train_2558 finds the answer early then loops, gsm8k_train_3643 position 2963 is a near-conclusion line break where the model continued thinking.
basis.structural_role: model.layers.23.mlp.down_proj columns 20/25/43 (last decoder layer MLP intermediate neurons) write directly into the final residual stream before model.norm and the tied output head.
basis.mechanism_hypothesis: Gate s=r.h_J (r=(0.645,0.583,0.495)) is high at concluded line breaks (dec 4.73/4.60, near-conclusion 4.06) and low at ordinary line breaks (ctrl <=1.33); adding alpha*u*r^T makes these neurons also write along u=unit(x_dec - x_ctrl), shifting conclusion-like states toward the observed </think>-emitting state.
basis.pairing_justification: Decision and control positions are newline tokens from the same generated prefixes (7251, 3643), so content differs mainly by conclusion status; loop positions from 2558 test the looping regime.
basis.value_derivation: Projection of layer-23 output on u: dec 7.25/7.27, near-conclusion 5.04, ctrl -1.24..0.40, loop -1.56..0.82. alpha=(7.26-5.04)/4.06=0.547 -> 0.54 so near-conclusion reaches the current decision level; ctrl shift <=0.72, loop (s=2.5) shift 1.35.
basis.alternative_explanation: u may encode prefix content of only two success contexts; looping may reflect uncertainty so forced termination yields wrong answers; or the gate may not activate in later loop states.
basis.expected_behavior: Teacher-forced lp(</think>) at 7251:1582 and 3643:2972 increases; reference NLL over 7 contexts changes <0.03; full generation shows fewer cutoffs and more correct boxed answers.
basis.disconfirming_result: lp(</think>) does not increase at decision positions, reference NLL rises >0.03 or token accuracy drops >0.01, or full generation cutoff/accuracy unchanged or old-correct answers lost.
